notes:
Account background: Polaris InsightWorks builds internal devtools for a large engineering org (50+ repos, monorepos + microservices). Recently consolidated multiple home-grown search silos into a single RAG pipeline evaluation. Primary pain: developer productivity when searching code and internal docs; false positives from naive lexical search.

Key contact list: • CTO - Anika Rao (technical sponsor) • Head of Platform - Marcos Velez • Dir. Eng (Search) - Jonas Meyer 

Technical constraints / ask (from workshops):
- Corpus size: ~120M file-level documents (code files + generated docstrings + design docs) leading to ~60M-140M vectors depending on chunking strategy.
- Reindex cadence: hourly diffs for active repos, full reindex nightly for stale branches; delta ingestion path must be <30s from commit to searchable.
- Latency targets: 95th perc <150ms for embedding lookup + reranking stage (end-to-end query) for code-search paths; relaxed for bulk similarity search.
- Throughput: ~300 qps peak across global dev teams; sustained 80-120 qps.
- Cost sensitivity: looking to keep avg cost per query (embedding + vector ops + rerank) <$0.004 for typical dev queries. Strong interest in batching and cache strategies from Redwood Optimize.
- Model preferences: open weights preferred (LLama-family, Mistral variants), but flexibility to fall back to hosted smaller reranker for latency-critical paths. Want control over quantization/FP configs.
- Reranking approach: two-stage: dense retrieval (ANN) -> cross-encoder reranker for top-12 candidates. POC expects Redwood to support a lightweight on-host cross-encoder or a low-latency remote rerank.
- Vector store expectations: prefer pluggable store (can evaluate Dedicated Redwood index vs self-managed Vespa/Pinecone). Concern about vendor lock and snapshot/restore semantics.
- Data governance: repo-level access controls, audit logs, retention controls (7y), and ability to exclude certain repos from embeddings.
- Auth: SSO/SAML + SCIM SCIM provisioning, strict IP allowlists for admin plane, customer-managed KMS.

POC status / timeline (CRM-style bullets):
- 2025-02-18: initial discovery + tech fit (fireflies ff_20250218_call_1129) -- agreed on evaluation metrics.
- 2025-02-25: architecture deep-dive with SE (Priya) - discussed incremental indexing design and reranker options (ff_20250225_tech_deepdive_1173).
- 2025-03-01: ingested 3 repos (~2M vectors) into Dedicated test pool; basic recall numbers look promising (P@5 improved vs lexical).
- 2025-03-04: performance run (synthetic qps) - observed 95th latency 210ms with current reranker; optimization opportunity: move reranker onto Dedicated host or use quantized cross-encoder.
- 2025-03-05: security kick-off with Polaris infosec; they requested SOC2 + KMS diagrams and sample audit logs (see drive links).

POC success criteria (from Polaris):
1) E2E dev query p95 <= 150ms for code search flows at 100 qps simulated.
2) Acceptable recall: P@5 >= 0.78 on internal eval set.
3) Incremental indexing latency <30s for diffs.
4) Cost <= $0.004/query at target QPS with Redwood Optimize recommendations.

Risks & open questions: 
- Reranker latency is current blocker; need validated path for on-host cross-encoder or third-party low-latency option.
- Snapshot/restore semantics for 100M+ vectors: how long to move between Dedicated and Private?
- Legal: need updated SOW and data residency clause for EU dev teams.

Quotes / paraphrases from contacts: "We need code search to feel instant for engineers — anything over 150ms kills adoption.", "We cannot re-index everything every push; need delta-first approach."

Next steps (short):
- SE (Priya) to run quantized reranker trial on Dedicated pool (target complete 2025-03-18).
- AE (Ethan) to circulate draft SOW + budget ask to Polaris finance (due 2025-03-20).
- Infra (Polaris) to provide sample SCIM/SAML IdP metadata and Git webhook schema for delta indexing by 2025-03-12.
- Set up legal NDA follow-up call (Ethan + Polaris legal) - schedule week of 2025-03-09.
notes_summary: Enterprise RAG for code search: large vector volumes, frequent delta reindexing, tight p95 latency target, SSO/SAML + KMS required. POC in progress; reranker latency is main technical blocker.
